document_purpose: Project-owned planning authority candidate for exactly one bounded Automation Control Plane integration pilot; not a replacement WashOps CRM product roadmap.

authority.acceptance_required: Separate WashOps-owner acceptance of the exact merged document and separately authorized Control Plane identity/adapter registration. Approval of this planning proposal never authorizes a run.

bounded_units.title: Static assessment of WashOps browser/server boundary test coverage
bounded_units.objective: Evaluate the existing browser-bundle boundary test against the documented frontend/server separation without executing application code, changing files, or claiming runtime bundle safety.
allowed_actions: Confirm canonical WashOps repository identity and immutable source revision.
Read only the declared source scope and directly referenced source files necessary to assess static imports.
Inspect supported frontend/server boundary declarations and report observed static coverage limitations.
Produce deterministic path/line findings and a structured factual handoff.
forbidden_actions: Do not run npm test, Vitest, builds, dependency installs, scripts, application imports or application code.
Do not access production or local databases, Supabase, tenant records, credentials, or environment secrets.
Do not modify any repository/worktree file, policy, branch, configuration, dependency or application behavior.
Do not call application endpoints, browse external sites, message users, deploy, publish or merge.
Do not touch open invoice/PDF PR #48 or shared invoice/storage/migration contracts.
Do not delegate mutating work, retry, resume, or start another work unit.
acceptance_criteria: Exact project, namespace, immutable commit and scope are verified before assessment.
Findings cite exact source paths/lines and separate what the test checks from what it cannot prove.
Any remote-model, authenticated GitHub, or durable-witness transport needed for a future admitted run is explicitly disclosed and separately authorized.
Trusted admission and native Hermes run/session IDs are correlated with exactly one durable normalized terminal receipt; a model assertion or STARTED state alone is not completion.
Structured validations, explicit completeness, changed_scope: [] and before/after unchanged target state are independently checked.
No execution continues after the assessment; human reviews the result, and any next unit requires new authority.
prerequisites: Project owner accepts this pilot source and unit after review/merge; acceptance does not imply eligibility.
Confirm no active conflicting WashOps lane or mutable shared-contract ownership, including PR #48.
Control Plane's applicable Windows source-verification PR #38 is separately reviewed and merged before reliance on that preparation path.
Control Plane source format adapter, identity, one-use admission/history and terminal evidence are separately implemented and independently verified offline.
Reliability gate and model-network/credential/host side-effect policy are explicitly adjudicated.
Control Plane lifecycle and backend policy remain parked/disabled until separate human approval to activate this one pilot.
Obtain fresh, exact, one-use human execution authorization after readiness and approval gates pass.
